basis: matt-skills-curated:code-review, adapted to repository review contract
notes: Reviewed the tracked E diffs and separately read the untracked crisisAdventure test; all 12 frozen source-path hashes match the final manifest.

The clone preflight invokes the internal combat resolver directly, so it does not recurse; emit capture uses a WeakMap keyed by the real state, while the clone is a distinct key. RNG and simulated state mutations are confined to the clone. No global dry-run effects were found.
The shared encounter constructor preserves ordinary encounter behavior while adding the optional objective; no temporary boss-flag or fabricated-world-state path was introduced.

Exact clone preflight cost scales with full state/history, with history capped at 20,000 records. Root approved retaining this design; performance remains for Phase6-I/J profiling and is not represented as browser-tested.

findings.description: The preserved public RED showed a MAX_SAFE_INTEGER-2 event sequence could accept camp start, then produce an unsaveable victory. Final code projects the one-hit start-to-victory path on an isolated clone before real start mutation and projects each camp combat turn before applying it; rejected operations leave real state unchanged.

notes: Both available levers are actual existing Goblin actions: a Chief defeat and a successful bounded Goblin camp raid. Civil Defense uses specialRelief=min(14, actual Chief 8 + actual camp success 6), subtracts it from max(causeFloor,currentPressure), and keeps a floor of 20; ordinary hunts cannot set the camp marker.

Raid start is restricted to a matching warning/preparation/active crisis before its deadline, a living idle player in the forest, non-dungeon state, and sufficient stamina. Only actual victory credits a marker, and current crisis ID/phase/deadline are checked at completion. Flee and death/succession provide no camp credit; a failed raid can be retried.

The V5-to-V6 migration adds the adventure default while preserving prior world, time, RNG, D contribution ledger, and save timestamp. The archived V5 fixture is from the exact base commit and is reused unchanged; it has nonempty equipment, food, and gold ledger entries.

Malformed in-flight objectives are rejected for wrong seed/sequence/time/monster/dungeon/kind. A legitimate old-crisis objective remains loadable across phase/new-crisis changes, but current-ID checks prevent late credit.
